taskTypes.name: Generic task
taskTypes.description: Plan, execute, review, summarize. Works for most requests.

steps.goal: Understand the goal, gather the context needed, and write a short concrete plan.
Execute the plan. Produce the actual deliverable (code, document, or answer).
Review the deliverable against the end goal. Fix small issues directly; report anything unresolved.
Write the final user-facing summary of what was done and where the outputs are.
